query:
SELECT MIN(start_time) AS "earliest?: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>",
                      MAX(end_time) AS "latest?: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>",
                      COUNT(*) AS "count!: i64"
               FROM time_window tw
               WHERE tw.task_id = ?1
                 AND (?2 IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.id = tw.task_id AND t.user_id = ?2))
